title: We Got Cristiano Ronaldo & Elon Musk in a Selfie Before GTA VI - NewsBreak
text:
By Anwaya Mane ,
44 minutes ago Image Credit: Andrew Harnik/Getty Images, Khalid Alhaj/MB Media/Getty Images Cristiano Ronaldo , Elon Musk , Georgina Rodríguez, and FIFA President Gianni Infantino posed for an internet-breaking selfie together. Ronaldo and his fiancée attended the White House dinner hosted by President Donald Trump. Needless to say, it spawned massive reactions on the internet.
Cristiano Ronaldo takes a selfie with Elon Musk in it Cristiano Ronaldo headlined a group selfie featuring Elon Musk at the White House dinner on Tuesday, November 18. The Portuguese footballer and his fiancée attended the glamorous night to welcome Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman to Washington, D.C. (via Daily Mail ).
Dressed in a dapper black tuxedo with a bow tie, Ronaldo snapped a quick selfie to commemorate the special occasion. The 40-year-old footballer held the camera horizontally to accommodate Rodríguez, Musk, and FIFA President Gianni Infantino. The photo also included tech founder and investor David Sacks and US secretary of commerce, Howard Lutnick.
Tech founder and investor David Sacks shared the selfie on his Instagram stories with the caption, “Great night”. Howard Lutnick also shared the selife on his Instagram account.
Unsurprisingly, the selfie, shared by PopBase’s X account, has garnered 3.7K likes, 307 saves, 728 retweets, and 451 comments at the time of writing this article. It has spawned massive, interesting reactions from users on the internet.
A lot of fans compared this star-studded selfie to Ellen DeGeneres’s iconic Oscar selfie featuring Brad Pitt, Angelina Jolie, Bradley Cooper, Jennifer Lawrence, and Meryl Streep, among other Hollywood stars. One fan commented , “The amount of power, money, and chaos in one frame is insane.” While a second user chimed in, “Did someone accidentally start an Avengers team in the White House?”
A third fan penned , “This looks like the most expensive group project ever,” accompanied by a laughing emoji. Finally, a user shared, “Bro, this selfie unlocked a whole new level of worlds colliding.”
Moreover, Trump paid tribute to the 40-year-old footballer during his speech at the dinner. He stated , “You know, my son is a big fan of Cristiano Ronaldo. We have Ronaldo here, I think my son respects his father a little more now that I’ve introduced you. Thank you for being here, it’s an honor.”
Notably, a lot of users were surprised to see Elon Musk at the glitzy dinner party after the former accused Trump of being involved in the Epstein case.
